description: Unit test class for KafkaBootstrapServerSpecificConfig, verifying its applicability, validation, and configuration application logic for Kafka bootstrap server settings within the project.

classes.name: KafkaBootstrapServerSpecificConfigTest
classes.description: JUnit test suite for KafkaBootstrapServerSpecificConfig, testing its methods and behaviors for various bootstrap server configurations.

methods.name: shouldAlwaysBeApplicable
methods.description: Test that KafkaBootstrapServerSpecificConfig is always applicable, regardless of connection configuration.

methods.name: shouldNotBeValidIfBootstrapServersAreEmpty
methods.description: Test that configuration is invalid if bootstrap servers are null or empty.

methods.name: shouldNotBeValidIfBootstrapServersDontMatchValidPattern
methods.description: Test that configuration is invalid if bootstrap servers do not match expected pattern.

methods.name: shouldBeValidForCorrectListOfBootstrapServers
methods.description: Test that configuration is valid when bootstrap servers are correctly formatted.

methods.name: shouldNotValidate
methods.description: Ensure that invalid configurations trigger validation exceptions.

methods.name: shouldValidate
methods.description: Ensure that valid configurations pass validation.

methods.name: shouldAddConnectionUriAsBootstrapServerIfBootstrapServersAreEmpty
methods.description: Checks that connection URI is used when bootstrap servers are missing.

methods.name: shouldAddCorrectListOfBootstrapServers
methods.description: Test that specified bootstrap servers are correctly added to configuration.

methods.name: shouldContainEachBootstrapServerOnlyOnce
methods.description: Ensure duplicate bootstrap servers are handled properly without duplication.
